# ASR smoke-test samples

`0.wav` and `2.wav` come unchanged from the official sherpa-onnx archive:
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-streaming-zipformer-small-bilingual-zh-en-2023-02-16.tar.bz2

These are public model examples, not user recordings. They exercise Chinese-English
code switching (weekday names and FREQUENTLY), not broad conference accuracy.
The model/source attribution and Apache-2.0 license are in `assets/asr_bilingual/`.
